summary: Iter316 — Frontend-only validation of 4 P2 deliverables (Admin Reports charts, Email Scheduling, Global Demo Mode toggle, Admin Safety Audio page). All 4 UI flows PASS end-to-end. Driver in-ride recorder skipped (headless mic limitation, backend already covered by pytest as documented in the request).
critical_code_review_comments: ReportSchedules.sendNow uses native window.prompt — fine for an admin-only tool but a styled modal would be more on-brand and easier to E2E-test.
AdminDemo wallet credit input uses defaultValue + onBlur, so React state and DOM can diverge if backend rejects the update; consider a controlled value with optimistic+rollback to stay consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 features verified, 5/5 reports show chart+KPIs, schedule CRUD round-trip OK, demo toggle ON->OFF OK, safety audio page renders)

test_credentials: admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! (login flow: 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' -> login-email-btn -> email/password)
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_Schedule_Iter316 ReportSchedule (id sch_3bdc718d53b7). Global Demo Mode was toggled ON then OFF; final state restored to OFF (initial). No residual test data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: visit /login, click 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion', scroll login-email-btn into view, click force=True, fill email+password, press Enter. /billing/reports route works (admin-reports-page). All 5 report kinds (results, payments, exceptional, refused-cancelled, other) returned non-empty rows AND a report-chart in the current 30d window. Schedule CRUD verified (create -> edit/cancel -> delete with native confirm; register dialog handler with page.once('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())). /admin/demo global-demo-toggle reveals/hides global-demo-credit-input; toast 'Mode Démo global ACTIVÉ' appears. /admin/safety-audio renders safety-empty when no recordings — that is expected. Driver in-ride recorder (safety-recorder/safety-record-btn) was NOT exercised because MediaRecorder cannot be triggered in headless Playwright without an active driver ride; the task statement explicitly allowed this skip.
